issues.description: Method visibility mismatch for PersonService.addParent(Person person, Person parent): the problem statement and template declare and describe addParent as a public service method to be invoked by controllers and tests. In template_repository/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/service/PersonService.java the method signature is public (public Person addParent(Person person, Person parent)). In solution_repository/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/service/PersonService.java the same method is declared private (private Person addParent(Person person, Person parent)). PersonResource (both template and solution) and the solution unit tests invoke personService.addParent(...), which requires the method to be public. The visibility difference causes a compilation/error mismatch and prevents the controller/tests from calling the method against the solution implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Restore public visibility for addParent in the solution implementation: change the method declaration in solution_repository/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/service/PersonService.java from 'private Person addParent(Person person, Person parent)' to 'public Person addParent(Person person, Person parent)'. This aligns the solution with the template, problem statement, controller usage, and tests. Alternatively, if a deliberate API change is intended, update PersonResource and all tests to call the correct public API, but the simplest remediation is to make addParent public.
